description.text: Stardust: ores (+2), amethyst (+3), ancient debris (+25), capped kills, Breath executions, Trials (40–180) and bosses (Guardian 150, Warden 250, Wither 300, Dragon 400). Each Rank and each Trial grants Skill Points: open the Skill Tree screen to spend them. Each branch offers two paths, only one can be taken.
